definition: Xinhua News Agency and Sogou of China developed an artificial intelligence (AI) for news reporting purposes.
details: The AI was unveiled in 2018. It is touted to be the "world's first AI news anchor".

explainer.lead: The Xinhua–Sogou AI news anchor is an AI for news reporting developed by Xinhua News Agency and Sogou of China. It matters as an early, widely publicized use of AI to present the news.

tiers.eli5: It is a computer-generated newsreader that looks and sounds like a person presenting the headlines on TV.
tiers.practitioner: Broadcasters use such systems to produce anchor-style video without a human on camera. The pitfall is that synthetic presenters can look uncanny or mispronounce, requiring review before airing.
tiers.paperLevel: A synthetic news-presentation system, unveiled in 2018 and described as the "world's first AI news anchor." The available details do not disclose its underlying generation method.

explainer.example: The system was unveiled in 2018 and presented as the world's first AI news anchor, reading news on camera without a human presenter.
